review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace the nonexistent Gemini model identifier**

When a reader runs this example (or any of the ADK examples changed in this commit), the request is sent to `models/gemini-3.8-flash`, but Google does not publish that model ID, so the API returns `404 NOT_FOUND` instead of generating content. The current recorded Google GenAI and ADK tests use the `gemini-2.5-flash` family, so switching all five runnable examples to this unsupported identifier makes them fail before they can demonstrate instrumentation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
